stories.title: As Kansans lose SNAP benefits, state lawmakers examine system hurdles
stories.summary_or_snippet: JC Post, republishing Kansas Reflector, reported fewer Kansans receiving SNAP benefits and described application delays and benefit-access hurdles under discussion by state lawmakers.

stories.approved_public_summary: JC Post, republishing Kansas Reflector, reported fewer Kansans receiving SNAP benefits and described application delays and benefit-access hurdles under discussion by state lawmakers.
stories.approved_why_it_matters: The source-visible evidence concerns food-assistance access, reduced SNAP participation, and administrative barriers for Kansans, including children; keep any public wording limited to those reported facts.
